subject.title: feat: optional info lines (IP, uptime, OS, location) on the name tag

question: Should Nameplate add opt-in persistent machine facts alongside the existing menu dashboard, with macOS shipping first and shared field identity/formatting defining later Windows/Linux parity?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and proven, but source inspection cannot decide whether the identity-focused overlay should expand into an operational dashboard or whether staged cross-platform rollout is intended.

options.title: Accept staged macOS rollout
options.body: Sponsor the feature, rebase it onto current main, and treat the shared field identifiers and ordering as the contract for later port parity.

options.title: Require simultaneous parity
options.body: Hold the PR until Windows and Linux provide matching settings, rendering, and formatter vectors.

options.title: Keep details menu-only
options.body: Decline the persistent presentation and preserve the current identity-focused name tag.

recommendation.title: Accept staged macOS rollout
recommendation.body: Sponsor the feature, rebase it onto current main, and treat the shared field identifiers and ordering as the contract for later port parity.
